generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
The bidder shall submit the duly signed declaration furnished in the bid document.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka public procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in price schedule in the website itself.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement Condition.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The successful bidder shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI prevailing as on the date of opening of financial bid.
The bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates. The successful bidder shall strictly adhere (GoKcircular no. /2023-24 dated:07.11.2023) to Rule 36 & 42 of Karnataka Mineral Concession Rules 1994 & its amendments thereof. If the successful bidder/agency fails to furnish documents related to remittance of royalty charges for Coarse aggregate, Fine aggregate, murrum etc., as per Rule 44(4) of Karnataka Mineral Concession (amendment) Rules 2023, prevailing royalty charges along with following penalty will be recovered from the work bills. a)A penalty of 5 times the royalty amount & additional payment(AP) of 40% royalty amount to Department of mines and Geology b)A penalty of 10% of royalty amount and the same will be transferred to District Mineral Foundation Trust.

The bidder should maintain register of workers deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority. Remittance towards PF shall be commensurate with the labour component of the work involved.
Bidder should have independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code.
In case the dates notified above declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.

The bidder shall register himself under section 7 and their workers who will be engaged for the works under section 12 of the Building and other construction workers (Regulation of employment & conditions of services) Act 1996.
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only.
The bidder shall quote item rates on the basis of prevailing market rate.

Bidders shall give declaration regarding payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the government from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him. Failing which, the bids are liable for rejection.

The successful bidder shall make payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the Government of Karnataka from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him.
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL.
The successful bidder shall obtain ESI coverage for all the workers deployed for this work if required.

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/document furnished by the bidder should the circumstances so warrant in the overall interest of the Corporation. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect or invalid, then tenders of such bidders will be cancelled and the EMD furnished by such bidders will be forfeited.
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of the contractor.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.

The successful bidder shall execute agreement by furnish Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) in the form of DD/NEFT or e-Bank Guarantee from any schedule bank acceptable to the Corporation, Insurance Surety Bonds issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India within 20 days of receipt of Letter of Intent through e-portal.
Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) shall be equivalent to 5% of the Contract amount and should be valid for 30 days after the date of completion of defect liability period.

Work completion period is 8(Eight) months (Including Monsoon). Defect liability period for the work is 120 Months from the date of completion of work. Contract period is 128(One Twenty Eight) months (i.e Work completion period and Defect liability period).
Power supply will be provided at free of cost wherever available. Otherwise agency has to make necessary arrangements at his own cost.
If Tenderer has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practices, action shall be initiated Finance Department, Government of Karnataka Notification No. FD 884 Exp-12/2019, Bengaluru, dated 7th May 2020.

Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from office of the Executive Engineer (Civil) Masthikatte, Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd., Masthikatte-577425, Hosanagara Taluk, Shivamogga District, during office hours. Mobile- 9449598842.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at-least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor One similar nature of work such as Water proofing/Retrofitting work to buildings of value not less than Rs.6.38 Lakhs during the proceeding five financial years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. The past experience should be supported by original scanned copy of the certificate issued from state / central Government / Government under taking /Reputed private firms from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre shall be furnished. (Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

Tender capacity - (A x N x 2.5-B), where, A-Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the Completed as well as works in progress. N-Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited for 0.67 years. B-Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the 0.67 years (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited)

itemList.description: Providing all material and labour and breaking the existing tiling, waterproof layer and plaster from walls and cleaning the existing floor by chipping, grinding and wire brushing/water jetting to remove traces of plaster, dirt, moss, etc., Including carting of debris to one place in the compound upto 30m from site.
Providing all material and labour and applying two coats of waterproofing slurry Dichtament DS with Nafufill BB2 at the consumption of 2 Kgs per square meter on sunk sides & walls.

Providing all material and labour and applying 15mm screed on bathroom sunk, sunk sides in cement: sand 1:5 with integral waterproofing admixure MC-Special Plus laid to proper slopes finished rough including making of coving at junction of floor and walls, curing etc., complete.

Providing all materials labour and applying double coat plaster up to 25mm thick to internal walls of brick work etc, in 1:4 cement:sand, mixed with integral waterproofing compound MC-Special Plus curing etc., complete.

Providing all material and labour and laying brickbat coba of average 100 mm thickness in cement: sand 1:5 with integral waterproofing admixure MC-Special Plus laid to proper slopes finished with IPS with chequred marking, curing etc., complete.

Providing all material and labour and grouting of pipe with non-shrink mortar Emcekrete type A including application of epoxy bond coat sprinkled with dry sand on pipes as well as concrete sides to match existing line and level.

Providing and fixing White Vitreous china Orissa pattern W.C. pan of size 580x440 mm with integral type foot rests (Indian type W.C. pan )with 100 mm sand cast Iron P or S trap, 10 litre low level white P.V.C. flushing cistern, including flush pipe, with manually controlled device (handle lever) conforming to IS : 7231, with all fittings and fixtures complete, including cutting and making good the walls and floors wherever required:

Providing and fixing white vitreous china pedestal type water closet(European type) with seat and lid, 10 litre low level white itreous china flushing cistern & C.P. flush bend with fittings & C.I. brackets, 40 mm flush bend, overflow arrangement with specials of standard make andmosquito proof coupling of approved municipal design complete, including painting of fittings and brackets, cutting and making goodthe walls and floors wherever required : 1W.C. pan with ISI marked white solid plastic seat and lid

Providing and fixing Sewer (SWR) pipes, including all fittings, This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step solvent cement, trenching, refilling & testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge.-110mm nominal dia pipes

Providing and fixing Unplasticised Polyvinyl Chloride (uPVC) pipes, for cold water supply including all uPVC plain & brass threaded fittings This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step uPVC solvent cement, trenching, refilling & testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge. External work-20 mm nominal dia Pipes

Providing and fixing trap of self cleaning design with screwed down or hinged grating with or without vent arm complete, including cost of cutting and making good the walls and floor: 100mm inlet and 75mm outlet, hubless centrfugally cast(spun) iron epoxy coated inside & outside as per IS:15905

Providing Brick work with common burnt clay Non Modular bricks of class designation 3.5 in superstructure above plinth level in all shapes and sizes in Cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement : 6 coarse sand) including cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding and usage charges of machinery & other incidental charges complete as per the direction of engineer incharge of work.

Providing 15 mm cement plaster on the rough side of single or half brick wall of mix 1:4 (1 cement: 4 fine sand) including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and laying Ceramic glazed floor tiles of size 300x300 mm (thickness to be specified by the manufacturer), of 1st quality conforming to IS : 15622, of approved make, in all colours, shades, except White, Ivory, Grey, Fume Red Brown, laid on 20 mm thick bed of cement mortar 1:4 (1 Cement : 4 Coarse sand), jointing with grey cement slurry @ 3.3 kg/ m2 including pointing the joints with white cement and matching pigments etc., complete.

Providing and placing on terrace(at all floor levels) polyethylene water storage tank, IS:12701 marked, with cover and suitable locking arrangements and making necessary holes for inlet, outlet and overflow pipes, but without fittings and base support for tank.
Providing and fixing 8 mm dia C.P. / S.S. Jet with flexible tube upto 1 metre long with S.S. triangular plate to Eureopean type W.C. of quality and make as approved by Engineer - in - charge.

Disposal of building rubbish / malba / similar unserviceable, dismantled or waste materials by mechanical means, including loading, transporting, unloading to approved municipal dumping ground or as approved by Engineer-in-charge to the appropriate disposal area.

Dismantling tile work in floors and roofs laid in cement mortar including stacking material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge. For thickness of tiles 10 mm to 25 mm
Dubbing out on old irregular walls average 10mm thick and making good the surface with cement mortar 1:3 including curing cost of materials, labour, complete as per specifications.

Providing 12 mm cement plaster with cement mortar 1:4 (1 cement:4 fine sand) to brick masonry including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge

Providing skirting, dadooing, rises of steps with colour glazed tiles 6mm thick on 10mm thick cement plaster 1:3 and jointed with white cement slurry over existing rough plaster surface using glazed tiles of approved make and size including cost of materials, labour, complete as per specifications.

Providing & fixing factory made PVC Door frame of size 50x47mm with a wall thickness of 5mm, made out of extruded 5mm rigid PVC foam sheet metered cut at corners & jointed 2 No.s of 150mm long brackets of 15x15mm M.S Square tube, the entire door frame to be reinforced with 19x19mm M.S Square tube of 19 gauge. The door frame to be fixed to the wall using M.S. Screws of 65/80mm size complete as per manufacturers specification & direction of Engineer-in-charge

Providing & fixing 30mm thick factory made rigid foam Prelam Panelled Door Shutters made from M.S. tube of 19x19mm, 19 gauge for stiles and 15x15mm for top & bottom rails, covered with heat moulded Prelaminated PVC C Channel of 5mm thick sheet & 30x50mm wide to form stiles & 5mm thick & 75mm wide Prelaminated PVC Sheets for top rail, lock rail & bottom rail on either side & 5mm thick, 20mm wide cross PVC sheet as gap insert for top rail & bottom rail, Panelling of 5mm thick PVC sheet Prelaminated on either side fitted in the M.S. frame, Sealed to the stiles & rails with PVC Designer beading on either side & joined together with solvent cement adhesive etc., Complete as per manufacturers specification & direction of Engineer-in-charge fixed to frames with 3 nos of 75mm Aluminium hinges. -do- with both side prelam
